run_detail.final_report_markdown:
# Redis 7.4 与 Valkey 8 的持久化选项与许可证差异比较

本次核验的官方资料显示，两者在持久化上都提供 RDB 快照与 AOF 机制，但细节描述不同：Valkey 8 的 RDB 按指定时间间隔对数据集做时间点快照，其 AOF 采用多部分机制（base 文件加增量文件）；Redis 7.4 的 RDB 被描述为紧凑的单文件时间点数据表示、适合备份，且其 AOF 支持每次写、每秒和禁用三种 fsync 策略。许可证方面差异明确：Valkey 8 使用 BSD 3-Clause 许可证，仅要求署名，而 Redis 7.4 起采用 RSALv2 或 SSPLv1 双许可。

## 直接回答

持久化方面，Valkey 8 的 RDB 持久化按指定时间间隔对数据集执行时间点快照，其 AOF 使用多部分机制，将原本单一的 AOF 文件拆分为至多一个 base 文件与多个增量文件，base 文件代表 AOF 重写时数据状态的初始快照。Redis 7.4 的 RDB 则被描述为紧凑的单文件时间点数据表示，适合用作备份，可按小时或每日保存快照；其 AOF 支持每次写、每秒及禁用三种 fsync 策略，其中每次写策略在实践中很慢，但支持组提交，在多个并行写入时会尝试执行单次 fsync 操作。 [evidence:8f9ca46ea15b621c3bcbd19aa156a5ece3ac6f1f24e48293] [evidence:28f82fbdce285699fab91b2fee4b0f0321934be256ab57e1] [evidence:c5555c9e9145366e8779dae77d4bc94abcac476f041b984b] [evidence:2840df25fbd0c5ffdda20f92546205cbdb0c1079aa079bec] [evidence:22e4bc2bddd031a9f3fa62cfa7462e71482a12f184114a3a] [evidence:8675ab0b6a026f2c70004ecf030c538871526cf2e72eeb18] [evidence:099168cf7a94a59e0c37cb5a1e16b23b42fcf0d3fd057743]

许可证方面，Valkey 8 使用 BSD 3-Clause 许可证，仅要求署名；Redis 7.4 则从 v7.4 起及其后所有版本采用 RSALv2 或 SSPLv1 双许可。 [evidence:f658db62ef2dc68e487637fbe1f4743e5b56bf52b4374f68] [evidence:8f8bd16ca9dd8c19ab03cfca7b4d8e05ebd9290372c76445]

## 持久化选项的比较

在 RDB 快照上，两个产品的资料都体现了时间点快照这一思路，但描述侧重不同。Valkey 8 的文档强调按指定时间间隔对数据集执行时间点快照，并提到可从 Redis 复制 RDB 文件到 Valkey；Redis 7.4 的文档则强调 RDB 是紧凑的单文件时间点数据表示，非常适合备份，可按小时或每日保存快照。 [evidence:8f9ca46ea15b621c3bcbd19aa156a5ece3ac6f1f24e48293] [evidence:28f82fbdce285699fab91b2fee4b0f0321934be256ab57e1] [evidence:22e4bc2bddd031a9f3fa62cfa7462e71482a12f184114a3a]

在 AOF 上，二者的关注点也有区别。Valkey 8 采用多部分 AOF 机制，把原来的单一 AOF 文件拆分为至多一个 base 文件与若干增量文件，base 文件代表 AOF 重写时数据状态的初始快照（RDB 或 AOF 格式）。Redis 7.4 的资料则聚焦 fsync 策略，列出每次写、每秒和禁用三种策略，并指出每次写策略在实践中很慢，但支持组提交，遇到多个并行写入时会尝试只执行一次 fsync。 [evidence:c5555c9e9145366e8779dae77d4bc94abcac476f041b984b] [evidence:2840df25fbd0c5ffdda20f92546205cbdb0c1079aa079bec] [evidence:8675ab0b6a026f2c70004ecf030c538871526cf2e72eeb18] [evidence:099168cf7a94a59e0c37cb5a1e16b23b42fcf0d3fd057743]

需要注意的是，上述持久化描述各自针对其产品文档所述的范围，不能据此推断另一产品缺少对应能力；本次核验的资料并未对两者的 RDB 或 AOF 实现做逐项对照。 [evidence:8f9ca46ea15b621c3bcbd19aa156a5ece3ac6f1f24e48293] [evidence:22e4bc2bddd031a9f3fa62cfa7462e71482a12f184114a3a] [evidence:c5555c9e9145366e8779dae77d4bc94abcac476f041b984b] [evidence:8675ab0b6a026f2c70004ecf030c538871526cf2e72eeb18]

## 许可证差异

许可证是两者差异最明确的部分。Valkey 8 采用 BSD 3-Clause，该许可证仅要求署名；Redis 7.4 则自 v7.4 起以及其后的所有版本采用 RSALv2 或 SSPLv1 双许可。对于需要评估再分发或商业使用条件的团队而言，这一区别是选择时最直接的考量因素。 [evidence:f658db62ef2dc68e487637fbe1f4743e5b56bf52b4374f68] [evidence:8f8bd16ca9dd8c19ab03cfca7b4d8e05ebd9290372c76445]

## 对比表

| 比较维度 | Redis 7.4 | Valkey 8 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| RDB 快照 | RDB 是紧凑的单文件时间点数据表示，适合备份，可按小时或每日保存快照 | 按指定时间间隔对数据集执行时间点快照；可从 Redis 复制 RDB 文件到 Valkey [evidence:22e4bc2bddd031a9f3fa62cfa7462e71482a12f184114a3a] [evidence:8f9ca46ea15b621c3bcbd19aa156a5ece3ac6f1f24e48293] [evidence:28f82fbdce285699fab91b2fee4b0f0321934be256ab57e1] |
| AOF 机制与 fsync | 支持每次写、每秒和禁用三种 fsync 策略；每次写策略实践上很慢，但支持组提交 | 采用多部分 AOF：至多一个 base 文件（初始 RDB 或 AOF 格式快照）加多个增量文件 [evidence:8675ab0b6a026f2c70004ecf030c538871526cf2e72eeb18] [evidence:099168cf7a94a59e0c37cb5a1e16b23b42fcf0d3fd057743] [evidence:c5555c9e9145366e8779dae77d4bc94abcac476f041b984b] [evidence:2840df25fbd0c5ffdda20f92546205cbdb0c1079aa079bec] |
| 许可证 | 自 v7.4 起及其后所有版本采用 RSALv2 或 SSPLv1 双许可 | BSD 3-Clause，仅要求署名 [evidence:8f8bd16ca9dd8c19ab03cfca7b4d8e05ebd9290372c76445] [evidence:f658db62ef2dc68e487637fbe1f4743e5b56bf52b4374f68] |

## Citation audit

### Valkey 8 · Persistence: RDB snapshot behavior

- Evidence: `evidence:8f9ca46ea15b621c3bcbd19aa156a5ece3ac6f1f24e48293`
- Exact quote: “DB persistence performs point-in-time snapshots of your dataset at specified intervals.”
- Snapshot: `research/external/f8b58d70-9539-4baf-a763-d75e9f104131/ad56567add15a4cf1a5363df89d61b6117d7c2e534ad8891a9a2be229f808b23`
- URL: https://valkey.io/topics/persistence/

### Valkey 8 · License

- Evidence: `evidence:f658db62ef2dc68e487637fbe1f4743e5b56bf52b4374f68`
- Exact quote: “Valkey uses BSD 3-Clause, which only requires attribution.”
- Snapshot: `research/external/f8b58d70-9539-4baf-a763-d75e9f104131/df5ef2568b7a18b909398add0cf9596913060c589ef71eb987c0871109128afd`
- URL: https://redis.io/blog/what-is-valkey/

### Valkey 8 · Persistence: AOF behavior

- Evidence: `evidence:c5555c9e9145366e8779dae77d4bc94abcac476f041b984b`
- Exact quote: “Valkey uses a multi part AOF mechanism. That is, the original single AOF file is split into base file (at most one) and incremental files (there may be more than one).”
- Snapshot: `research/external/f8b58d70-9539-4baf-a763-d75e9f104131/ad56567add15a4cf1a5363df89d61b6117d7c2e534ad8891a9a2be229f808b23`
- URL: https://valkey.io/topics/persistence/

### Redis 7.4 · Persistence: RDB snapshot behavior

- Evidence: `evidence:22e4bc2bddd031a9f3fa62cfa7462e71482a12f184114a3a`
- Exact quote: “RDB is a very compact single-file point-in-time representation of your Redis data. RDB files are perfect for backups.”
- Snapshot: `research/external/a88b5096-6ed4-4b7e-9fce-6f4d9398e059/933fa35e7c8ae67229a76e522d694ec654db8c013c57da9e74928e2e4d591917`
- URL: https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/oss_and_stack/management/persistence/

### Redis 7.4 · License

- Evidence: `evidence:8f8bd16ca9dd8c19ab03cfca7b4d8e05ebd9290372c76445`
- Exact quote: “version 2](/legal/rsalv2-agreement/) (RSALv2) or the Server Side Public License version 1 (SSPLv1) starting with Redis v7.4 and for all future releases of Redis.”
- Snapshot: `research/external/b6f25592-7825-4c74-ac53-edaeca83b212/f1481d4d8f7e2e5def113013a8fea0cb14aedf10b6a14c3d704ef5a25e70f68e`
- URL: https://redis.io/blog/redis-adopts-dual-source-available-licensing/

### Redis 7.4 · Persistence: AOF behavior

- Evidence: `evidence:8675ab0b6a026f2c70004ecf030c538871526cf2e72eeb18`
- Exact quote: “Redis supports three fsync policies: every write, every second, and disabled.”
- Snapshot: `research/external/a88b5096-6ed4-4b7e-9fce-6f4d9398e059/ac8aa3aaa0ec3c5ca7f4b61251045f74fe0677d993d85b53b0f61150341ab43f`
- URL: https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/7.4/databases/configure/database-persistence/

brief.deliverable: Markdown research report with exact quotes, snapshots, URLs, and citation audit.

perspectives.name: Decision maker
questions: Is either version free for commercial use without restriction?
Which persistence options are officially documented?
